College at a Glance
Recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and affiliated to the Gauhati University, Guwahati, Assam, Chatia College is a premier institute of higher learning in Sootea, Dist.- Biswanath, Assam offering Bachelor of Arts (BA) Regular & Honours programmes under the Choice based Credit System (CBCS). It was established in the year 1982 with the unwavering endeavour of some leading citizens and the public of greater Sootea area. The College is situated at the heart of Sootea around 1 km away from the NH – 15 in its own plot of land which covers an area of about 7.5 acres.The College has Arunachal Pradesh to the North, the mighty Brahmaputra river to the South, the Ghiladhari river to the East, and the Dekorai river to the West. About 72 villages comprise the areas immediately surrounding the College. The serene and eco-friendly campus with two playgrounds for various sports and games adds to the beauty of this institution

Core Values of Chatia College
"We are committed to creating an inclusive, sustainable, and socially responsible learning community that promotes lifelong learning, community engagement, and appreciation of diverse perspectives and cultures"
01.
The College values inclusivity and strives for equal opportunities regardless of socio-economic status, background or physical ability.
02.
The College acknowledges the significance of community involvement and strives to engage with local communities to promote educational opportunities and awareness.
03.
The College emphasizes lifelong learning and encourages students to pursue practical opportunities beyond the classroom.
04.
The College emphasizes sustainability and endeavors to promote environmental responsibility and integrate sustainable practices into its operations.
05.
The College prioritizes diversity and encourages appreciation of diverse perspectives and cultures through exposure to diverse populations and cultural exchanges.
